maria: Quick design review: rollout breadcrumb + allocation pill + rollback icon. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/rollout-console?node-id=88. Need copy + a11y locked for next minor. ashok: SR order is key. Screen readers need context: Release > Variant > allocation. Keep pill short but add aria-label='50% allocation to Variant A'. kai: Visuals: pill contrast fails at 11px. Raise to 12px or change color to reach 4.5:1. Also consider colorblind-safe combos. jess: Product prefers term 'allocation' in console. Keep crumb concise. tim: Pill must not be keyboard-focusable. Use role='text' and ensure focus lands on the link. Add aria-current="page" for active variant. a11y-bot: Color scan: #6C6CFF on #FFFFFF = 2.7:1. Recommend #3F3FD9 (4.7:1) or add subtle outline + padding. Focus indicator must be visible. maria: Rollback icon currently reads as actionable. Make it informational: role='img' with sr-only text 'Rollback available' and cursor:default. If we add action later, convert to button semantics. ashok: Suggest aria-describedby linking pill to an offscreen helper: 'Allocation is percent of user traffic routed to this variant.' maria: For live updates, use aria-live='polite' on status area with 2s debounce to avoid spammy reads. tim: PR snippet: ```
  1. Release v12
  2. Variant A 50% Allocation is percent of user traffic routed to the variant.
``` kai: I'll run contrast + daltonism checks and post swatches. jess: Target next minor. Maria will update Figma by EOD Fri; tim will draft PR next Wed. maria: Thanks all, will post updates here. :thumbsup:
